race.comment: DIRTY LIL' DIVA (10) resumes from a five-month break with first-time blinkers, a 2kg claim and a latest trial that was a close second at Gold Coast, so she has enough new factors to improve on two winter runs in NSW. INZAIN DRAGON (5) was narrowly beaten on debut as favourite before finishing fourth at the Gold Coast, and third-up fitness keeps him firmly in the mix. SYMO'S BOY (3) comes off a third at this track and has two placings from four tries around 1150m. Should be hitting his straps now and is drawn cosy. In the mix. JOHNNY THE FOX (11) has good tactical speed and is race-fit. Expect him to give a bold sight.
